dedupe_keys.name: flow and detailed 3d morphodynamic data from laboratory experiments of fluvial dike breaching

description: Flow and detailed 3D morphodynamic data from laboratory experiments of fluvial dike breaching is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Ismail Rifai et al. This paper presents a dataset obtained from fifty four laboratory experiments of the breaching of fluvial dikes due to flow overtopping. Data were collected on two complementary experimental setups, each consisting of a main channel representing the river, an erodible lateral dike and a floodplain. The dataset covers seven test series, involving varying hydraulic boundary conditions (e.g. Coverage: a single site or case study; published in 2019. Formats: HDF5, MATLAB, TXT, Image, Point cloud. The data are held in Zenodo and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-3.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
